summary: Analyzed and broken the 3-way circular dependency in the provider onboarding and vetting workflow.
evidence: Identified the circular lock between Provider Vetting -> Admin Dashboard -> Provider Data -> Provider Vetting.
Proved that reordering alone cannot resolve cyclic design flaws.
Resolved the cycle by introducing state decoupling (PENDING_REVIEW vs APPROVED) and interface decoupling (headless approval API before UI).
